analysis: holding MFE and post-stop recovery, descriptive follow-up v1
owner_request: 统计过最大打到的 R 吗，还有止损后立马又回来的这种呢
risk: Original entry minus original stop, signed by side; frozen after exit.
clock: Start at the stop-hit 5m bar close; observe only subsequent complete 5m bars. Exclude the ambiguous remainder of the stop-hit bar. Timing is bar resolution, not exact execution time.
boundary: Do not cross original segment right edge. A horizon contributes only when fully observed; report censored counts.
holding_mfe: Keep conservative existing peak_r and independently reconstruct it. Stop-hit bar favorable wick excluded; its possible contribution recorded separately as an upper bound.
recovery: Touch and 5m close reclamation of entry are separate. Post-exit R is a hypothetical price displacement, not a realized trade return.
adverse_excursion: For entry recovery, include stop-hit bar and recovery-hit bar full adverse extremes as a conservative adverse bound; intrabar order unknown.
control: Reuse frozen same-side/week/causal-volatility matched random entries; show stopped-population rates and jointly eligible pairs where both stopped, explicitly conditional.
scope: No new strategy or parameter selection. No Pine changes, reentry performance claims, or live actions.
